---
title: "Methods & reproducibility"
---

## The model in brief

The stress test is an agent-based model of 67 euro-area significant institutions. A
shock marks down bank assets and triggers a continuous depositor-run response; each
bank then meets its liquidity need by searching over four funding channels — outright
**sales**, **unsecured** borrowing, private **repo**, and **central-bank credit** —
ranking feasible combinations by their implications for prices, haircuts, capital,
leverage and risk-weighted capital rather than following a fixed pecking order. Sales
feed back into asset prices; pledging encumbers collateral across the repo and
central-bank windows. The cascade runs in weekly steps to convergence (well within a
15-week horizon).

The **channel-mask arms** switch the channels on cumulatively — sales only
($\mathcal{M}^{S}$), then unsecured ($\mathcal{M}^{SU}$), repo ($\mathcal{M}^{SUR}$),
and central-bank credit ($\mathcal{M}^{SURC}$) — so the difference between consecutive
arms isolates each channel's marginal contribution.

## Data

| Input | Source | Confidential? |
|-------|--------|---------------|
| Balance-sheet composition & encumbrance | ECB FINREP | Yes — never published |
| Loan-book (credit-claim) composition | ECB AnaCredit | Yes — never published |
| Collateral eligibility & central-bank haircuts | ECB Eligible Assets dataset | Public |
| Private-repo haircuts | LCH acceptable-collateral schedule | Public |
| Market depth & sales discounts | Derived from public market data | Public |
| Shock calibration | EBA 2021 adverse stress test | Public |

The panel is the December 2021 vintage. Bank identities and any bank-level figures are
confidential and never appear on this site or in the paper.

## Confidentiality on this site

Everything shown here is **aggregated to groups of at least three banks**. The site is
built from a curated export of group- and system-level results only; it never contains
bank-level rows, identifiers, or the underlying supervisory inputs. Country groups with
fewer than three banks are pooled into a residual group.

## Headline calibration

The frictions active in the headline runs:

```{ojs}
cal = FileAttachment("../data/calibration_friction.csv").csv({typed: true})
Inputs.table(cal, {
  columns: ["knob", "value", "source"],
  header: {knob: "Parameter", value: "Value", source: "Source / note"},
  rows: 20, layout: "auto"
})
```

## Reproducibility

Every figure and table traces to a single script with a fixed seed. The stochastic arms
(repo and central-bank credit) are averaged over ten seeds with cross-seed standard
errors; the sales-only and unsecured arms are deterministic. A locked regression
baseline pins the model's determinism, and this site's data layer is produced by one
export script that enforces the aggregation rules above.
